newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo allots 120 mln shares in OPV.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo allots 120 mln shares in OPV.

text.p: Italy's San Paolo di Torino allotted 120 million shares to its public sale offer (OPV) carried out last week, out of a global offer of 220 million, a newspaper tombstone said.

It gave final figures for applications for shares in the offer. The OPV registered applications from the public for 442,769,000 shares from 389,040 applicants, and a further 20,126,500 shares were requested by 15,902 employees.
In the institutional part of the offer in Italy there were applications for 118,880,484 shares by 115 investors.
